", "data:audio/mpeg;base64,"];
    const conceptAudio = new Audio();
    conceptAudio.preload = 'metadata';
    let activeConceptAudio = null;
    let conceptRequest = 0;
    function updateConceptAudioControls() {
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-concept-audio]').forEach(button => {
        const playing = Number(button.dataset.conceptAudio) === activeConceptAudio && !conceptAudio.paused;
        button.textContent = playing ? '⏸ إيقاف مؤقت' : '🔊 استماع';
        button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(playing));
      });
    }
    function stopConceptAudio() {
      conceptRequest++;
      conceptAudio.pause();
      updateConceptAudioControls();
    }
    async function playConceptAudio(id) {
      stopIntroSequence();
      stopKasroonVoice();
      lastLearningAudio = {type: 'concept', id};
      stopFeedbackAudio();
      if (!conceptRecordings[id]) return;
      if (!soundEnabled) { showToast('فعّل الصوت من زر 🔇 أولاً'); return; }
      if (activeConceptAudio === id && !conceptAudio.paused) { stopConceptAudio(); return; }
      stopWelcomeAudio();
      stopDialogueAudio();
      stopGeneratedNarration();
      conceptAudio.pause();
      const request = ++conceptRequest;
      if (activeConceptAudio !== id || conceptAudio.ended) {
        conceptAudio.src = conceptRecordings[id];
        conceptAudio.currentTime = 0;
      }
      activeConceptAudio = id;
      try { await conceptAudio.play(); }
      catch (error) {
        if (request === conceptRequest && error.name !== 'AbortError') showToast('تعذّر تشغيل التسجيل، اضغط استماع للمحاولة مجددًا');
      }
      updateConceptAudioControls();
    }
    ['playing', 'pause', 'ended'].forEach(event => conceptAudio.addEventListener(event, updateConceptAudioControls));

    function escapeStudentText(value) {
      return String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, char => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[char]));
    }
    function cleanStudentName(value) {
      return String(value || '').replace(/[<>\u0000-\u001f\u007f\u202a-\u202e\u2066-\u2069]/g, '').slice(0, 40);
    }
    function saveStudentProfile() {
      try { sessionStorage.setItem('fractions-student-profile', JSON.stringify({name: state.studentName, encouragement: state.encouragementEnabled})); } catch (_) {}
    }
    function setStudentName(value) {
      state.studentName = cleanStudentName(value);
      saveStudentProfile();
    }
    const encouragementPhrases = {
      neutral: ['أنت رائع', 'ما شاء الله، أنت بطل']
    };
    let encouragementIndex = 0;
    let encouragementTimer = null;
    let pendingEncouragement = false;
    function speakEncouragement(preview = false) {
      if (!soundEnabled || !state.encouragementEnabled) return;
      const name = cleanStudentName(state.studentName).trim();
      if (!conceptAudio.paused && !preview) { pendingEncouragement = true; return; }
      pendingEncouragement = false;
      const phrases = encouragementPhrases.neutral;
      const phrase = phrases[encouragementIndex++ % phrases.length];
      const message = name ? `يا ${name}، ${phrase}!` : `${phrase}!`;
      if (preview) stopDialogueAudio();
      showToast(message);
      playFeedbackRecording(feedbackRecordings.success[(encouragementIndex - 1) % feedbackRecordings.success.length]);
    }
    conceptAudio.addEventListener('ended', () => {
      if (pendingEncouragement) speakEncouragement();
    });
